extraction_instruction: You are NuExtract, an information extraction tool created by NuMind. Extract every atomic factual assertion from the document into claims. Each statement must preserve negation, uncertainty, units, and workload or version conditions. A quote must be an exact contiguous passage from the document that supports the statement. Conditions must be exact text fragments from the document. Do not invent missing facts or interpret a reported test as a universal guarantee. Preserve assertions that information was not recorded or a configuration was not tested. Questions and future plans are not factual assertions. Return only the JSON requested by the template.

extraction_examples.input: On device Birch with driver 2.1, the cedar kernel took 9 ms. No firmware version was recorded.
extraction_examples.output: {"claims": [{"statement": "The cedar kernel took 9 ms on device Birch with driver 2.1.", "quote": "On device Birch with driver 2.1, the cedar kernel took 9 ms.", "conditions": ["device Birch", "driver 2.1"]}, {"statement": "The firmware version was not recorded.", "quote": "No firmware version was recorded.", "conditions": []}]}

relation_instruction: Compare the supplied claims as assertions made by sources, without assuming either source is true. Return only the JSON template. Use contradicts only if the same subject, property, run and compatible conditions have incompatible assertions. Use supports for equivalent compatible assertions, including equivalent units. Use different_scope when an explicit difference in workload, version, configuration or metric explains the difference. Use insufficient_information when the conditions cannot be matched, or one claim does not establish or refute the other. Not tested does not mean failed. Include a short reason.

relation_examples.input:
Claim A: In run E2, all 10 checks passed.
Claim B: In run E2, zero of the 10 checks passed.
relation_examples.output: {"relation": "contradicts", "reason": "The same run has incompatible outcomes for the same ten checks."}
